title: AAPL: market focus shifts as positive sentiment returns
summary: earnings beat and strong guidance lift sentiment for AAPL.
content: AAPL continues to show positive market momentum. Analysts note higher demand, stronger execution, and improved operating leverage. The company remains focused on margin discipline and inventory control.

title: AAPL: market focus shifts as neutral sentiment returns
summary: revenue momentum and demand expansion improve outlook for AAPL.
content: AAPL remains in a mixed phase with stable cash generation and moderate growth. The market is watching margin improvements and any signs of stronger than expected demand.
